settings_shell_crawler_purpose: Adjust discovery, fetch limits and peer transport.
settings_shell_network_purpose: Review addresses, ports and network configuration.
settings_shell_no_changed: No changed settings in this section.
settings_shell_unavailable: This Settings screen is not available in this build.
settings_shell_server_unavailable: This server does not provide settings for this section.
settings_shell_network_readonly: Network settings are read-only in this build. Address recovery and connection checks are not yet available here.
settings_shell_guarded_readonly: Settings that need a separate confirmation flow are read-only in this screen.
settings_shell_overview_purpose: Choose a section to review its current values and save changes together.
settings_shell_overview_unknown: Installation health and restart status are not available in this overview yet.
settings_shell_export_description: Download the settings saved in Lodestar as a TOML export file. Unsaved edits are not included. This file uses the settings export format, not the config.toml layout.
settings_shell_export_exclusions: Secrets, environment-controlled values, read-only values, and filter, floor, pack or subscription state are excluded. This is a settings export, not a backup of your library.
settings_shell_export_failed: Could not download settings. Try again when Lodestar is available.
settings_shell_export_started: Download started. Check your browser’s downloads.
